# La Liga SP1 Incremental Fixture-Gap Reconciliation — Evidence Report (req-20261002-008)

Scope: La Liga seasons 2018/19, 2024/25, 2025/26. Retrieval window: 2026-10-02 09:42–10:05 CST.
Role: evidence collector only. No Qimen palaces, F/I/G tokens, model directions, or conclusions were generated (per request §4d).

## Q(a) 2018/19 — row-level schedule with local kickoff time + official round

### Primary schedule source (rounds + local kickoff times)
- **URL:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openfootball/es-espana/master/2018-19/1-liga.txt
- **final_url:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openfootball/es-espana/master/2018-19/1-liga.txt (direct file; no redirects)
- **retrieved_at:** 2026-10-02T09:45+08:00
- **field_locator:** text blocks `▪ Matchday N` → `  <Weekday> <Mon> <DD> [(<YYYY>)]` → `    <HH:MM>  <Home>  v  <Away>  <HG>-<AG> (<HTHG>-<HTAG>)`. Rows sharing a kickoff slot omit the time (inherit previous line's time). Times are Spain-local (CEST in Aug–Oct/Mar–May; CET in Nov–Feb).
- **source_sha256:** 01121b41832cdd3349771de9e2bfc8c656b35961555f1198254f0648253a14fc
- **coverage:** 38 matchdays × 10 = 380 fixtures.

### Corroborating source (dates + results identity)
- **URL / final_url:** https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/1819/SP1.csv
- **retrieved_at:** 2026-10-02T09:44+08:00
- **field_locator:** CSV header `Div,Date,HomeTeam,AwayTeam,FTHG,FTAG,...` (no `Time` column in the 1819 format). Crosswalk key = (Date, canon(Home), canon(Away)) with NFKD accent normalization + alias map {Athletic Club/Ath Bilbao→bilbao, Rayo Vallecano→vallecano, Atlético/Ath Madrid→madrid, Real Sociedad→sociedad, Espanyol (Español)→espanol, etc.}
- **source_sha256:** 9b8cece2c85e90e382b30dc4fc5046534f12c6d2b0efa74cd7d1d52e90a0c201
- **crosswalk result:** matched=380 / unmatched=0 / score_mismatch=0. Every OpenFootball row found in football-data SP1_1819 on (date, home, away) and full-time scores agree on all 380.
- Full row-level crosswalk artifact: generated locally during research (not pushed to repo): `/tmp/req008/crosswalk_1819.csv` — 380 rows [matchday, date, time_cet, of_home, of_away, canon_home, canon_away, in_fd, score_match].

### Timezone caveat (verified)
- Verified against Athletic Club official match pack: Athletic Bilbao v Getafe, 15/08/2024, official kickoff **19:00 CEST** (https://www.athletic-club.eus/en/news/2024/08/15/match-pack-athletic-club-vs-getafe-cf/). football-data.co.uk `Time` column for the same fixture reads **18:00** → football-data `Time` is **UK-local (BST/GMT), NOT Spain-local**. OpenFootball 20:15/22:15-style times are Spain-local (CEST). Q(b) does not require kickoff times, but do not treat the two sources' time columns as the same timezone.

## Q(b) 2024/25 + 2025/26 — API5 odds gap queue (Bet365 / Pinnacle / William Hill 1X2 only)

All row-level odds below come from one stable source; no API-Football and no true-opening substitution was made.

### Source & semantics
- **2024/25 URL / final_url:** https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/2425/SP1.csv — retrieved 2026-10-02T09:44+08:00 — sha256 c086e96d6a53f6e6c0fce4e35db0d1728c773b4362323da0161a34769e315a36
- **2025/26 URL / final_url:** https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/2526/SP1.csv — retrieved 2026-10-02T09:44+08:00 — sha256 4ca2e285f3ee0702f6bc55fcaa4f5a15cb3aef6220735a1d15398131e21d63f5
- **Bookmaker column keys** (per https://www.football-data.co.uk/notes.txt, retrieved 2026-10-02T09:45+08:00): Bet365 = `B365H/B365D/B365A`; Pinnacle = `PSH/PSD/PSA`; William Hill = `WHH/WHD/WHA`.
- **Time semantics (from notes.txt, verbatim):** base odds columns are **pre-closing** — "Betting odds for weekend games are collected Friday afternoons, and on Tuesday afternoons for midweek games." Columns with a `C` suffix (`B365CH/B365CD/B365CA`, `PSCH/PSCD/PSCA`, `WHCH/WHCD/WHCA`) are **closing** odds. Neither is a **true opening** quote; the base columns must NOT be relabeled as opening.
- **Live odds:** not published by this source → no evidence.

### Fixture IDs for gap rows
Rows are keyed (Div=SP1, Date dd/mm/yyyy, HomeTeam, AwayTeam) in the CSVs. The William Hill gap rows (2024/25, 101 pre-close / 102 closing) and the post-2026-01-12 Pinnacle gap rows (2025/26) are all preserved as NULL rows in the source files; exact date/home/away lists can be extracted from the CSVs by filtering empty `WHH` / `PSH` fields. No conflicts observed: 0 (no second source provided row-level odds for the same fixtures).
